description: This file defines the EmailWorkflowService class responsible for handling email workflows in a scheduling/booking system. It includes methods for generating email content, handling email sending tasks, and constructing links for rescheduling and cancellation, with integrations to various external modules and services.

classes.name: EmailWorkflowService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing email workflows, including generating email content, handling email sending, and constructing relevant links for calendar events.

methods.name: handleSendEmailWorkflowTask
methods.description: Handles the process of sending email workflow tasks, including fetching workflow reminders, generating email content, and sending emails.

methods.name: generateParametersToBuildEmailWorkflowContent
methods.description: Generates parameters required to build email content based on workflow step, event data, and other context.

methods.name: shouldHideBranding
methods.description: Determines whether branding should be hidden based on platform, user, or team context.

methods.name: generateEmailPayloadForEvtWorkflow
methods.description: Creates the email payload including subject, body, attachments, and reply-to information based on event data and email action.

methods.name: buildCancelLink
methods.description: Constructs a cancellation link, either platform-specific or standard, based on event and context.

methods.name: buildRescheduleLink
methods.description: Constructs a rescheduling link, either platform-specific or standard, based on event and context.
